configs.description: The finger duct as Tripp Lite ships SRCABLEDUCT1U, the cover fitted.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The same duct with the cover taken off, the two slotted walls and the channel between them open to lay a cable in. The cover comes with the duct, so this is an illustration and not a device type.
configs.name: cover-off

gaps.note: neither the spec sheet nor the submittal drawing states how many cables the duct holds, a fill or a bend radius.
gaps.wanted: a cable capacity and its basis from the owner's manual or the SKU page

gaps.note: no document says how the cover is held on or removed, so it is drawn as one plate that lifts off; the format has no clip.
gaps.wanted: the owner's manual page that shows the cover fitted

gaps.note: the back view draws five bosses, four slotted dimples and small holes beside each boss; no document says what they are for. The dimples and bosses are drawn at estimated sizes, the small holes are not drawn, and no pass-through is declared.
gaps.wanted: the owner's manual or a dimensioned back view
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - material (cold rolled steel, the drawing's specification table), colour (black), the mounting hardware (included) and compliance (RoHS; EIA/ECA-310-E) are the spec sheet's.

capacity.note: datasheet - no cable capacity, fill or bend radius is stated in either document. None is recorded and none is estimated; a gap says so.

chassis.note: drawing - 482.6 x 43.69 x 67.71 (19.00 x 1.72 x 2.67 in): the front view dimensions the first two and the top view the third. The body is narrower than the plate, 39.8 mm across its walls (estimated: read off the side view at 2.59 px/mm, where it is 103 px against 113 across the ears), and the cover's lips stand outside the walls, 1.1 mm each, 42.0 mm over them, which agrees with the front view's 42.3.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black" and "cold rolled steel with black finish" are the spec sheet's. The drawing is line work and the photograph on it is the maker's, so the whole is this library's render of black steel. Its greys are lifted from near-black so the part reads on the explorer's dark stage as well as on a white one: a lit edge on the cover and the wall bars, a darker slot.

cover.note: datasheet - the cover ships fitted (the spec sheet's title, Highlights and Package Includes: "finger duct with cover"). The submittal drawing's top and side views draw it fitted; no document says how it is held or taken off. It is drawn fitted in `base` and absent in `cover-off`, as a lid (`lid: true`). The format has no clip, so none is drawn.

ears.note: drawing - a rack-face part is its ears and what hangs off them, so the face is the 482.60 mm over the ears and the ears are the 25.4 at each end of the back plate (the duct between them is dimensioned 431.80 mm [17.00 in]). Each has two slots: 8.8 mm in from the end (465 mm between hole centres) and 32 mm [1.26 in] apart across the 43.69. The slot size, 12 x 6 mm, is read off the picture at 2.41 px/mm (estimated).

front.note: drawing - the cover, fitted: the front view draws the face of the duct, 431.80 long, with the ears at each end. The two walls and the channel between them are the side view's: 37.57 mm clear between the walls over the 58.79 mm [2.31 in] from the underside of the cover to the inside of the back. The `duct` guide is that channel, over the full length.

guides.note: estimated - THE FINGERS ARE ON BOTH WALLS, AND THE PITCH IS COUNTED, NOT DIMENSIONED. The top view draws one wall and dimensions only a bar, 10 mm [.39 in], and the slot length, 49.78 mm [1.96 in]. Counted on it: 24 slots, centres 1000 px apart over 23 pitches at 2.416 px/mm, so the pitch is 18.0 and the slot 8.0 (a 10 mm bar, an 8.0 mm slot; the first and last bars run to the ends and are 4.9). The page-1 isometric shows slots in the top wall and in the wall under the open end, which is why the bottom is drawn as the top again; the side view draws two equal walls. The slots are punched, closed at both ends, so a finger is held at both ends: no tip is free. A cable is laid along the channel and passes between the walls through a slot.

left.note: drawing - the side view: the back plate, the two walls with the channel between them, and the cover's plate and lips over the front, drawn the cover over the walls. The duct is open at both ends and a cable runs out of it there: nothing is built across the ends. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE SUBMITTAL DRAWING, page 2. It draws a front, top, back and side view with millimetres in brackets. The front view is 2.41 px/mm across the 482.60 (1163 px) and the top view 2.416 across the 431.80 (1043 px), 0.2 per cent apart: both are orthographic. Page 1's isometric is a picture of the shape and carries no dimension.

mount.note: drawing - `rack-face`: the part bolts to the rail face at one rack unit through the slots in its ears and stands out of it (front view, ears 465 mm [18.31 in] between hole centres; top view, 62.71 mm [2.47 in] from the front of the cover to the plane of the ears). The back plate stands 5.0 mm behind that plane, inside the rack's opening. `depth` is the maker's overall 67.71, which counts those 5.0 mm, so the part stands 62.71 in front of the rail face and the library's depth is 5.0 more than that.

rear.note: drawing - the back view: the plate 482.6 long with its ears, five bosses 100 mm apart (400 over the five, dimensioned) centred on the duct, and four larger round dimples between them at 50 mm either side of the centre and of the middle boss (the 300 mm dimension, slot to slot of the outer two), each with a slot. Their diameters (11.6 for a boss, 6.0 for its inner ring, 26 for a dimple, with a slot 11 x 3.3) are read at 2.41 px/mm and are estimated. THE PURPOSE OF THESE IS NOT STATED by any document and no pass-through is declared: a slot in a dimple reads as a tie slot, which the maker does not say. The small holes round each boss are not drawn.

size-conflict.note: TWO SIZES ARE PUBLISHED AND THE MAKER'S OWN WINS. Resellers list 1.77 x 3.9 x 19.13 in; the spec sheet states unit dimensions 1.720 x 19.000 x 2.660 in (hwd, 4.37 x 48.26 x 6.77 cm) and the submittal drawing states 1.72 x 2.67 x 19.00 in (43.7 x 67.7 x 482.6 mm). The drawing dimensions each of them on a view: 43.69 high over the ears, 482.60 long, 67.71 out. The reseller's figures match no view and are not used. The drawing's title row labels its three figures H x W x D while giving them in the order height, depth, width; the views settle which is which. The spec sheet's 2.660 in is the drawing's 2.67 in (67.71 mm) to the printing.

sources.note: THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS. The SRCABLEDUCT1U spec sheet (assets.tripplite.com, 2 pages, © 2026 Eaton) and the SRCABLEDUCT1U submittal drawing (assets.tripplite.com, 2 pages, © 2016 Tripp Lite, 16-08-508). The Eaton SKU page was tried once (the .html and the skuPage .pdf export both fail at the connection with an HTTP/2 stream error, and a regional copy timed out), so no owner's manual or other download was read. No document names terms of use for the drawing; figures were read and nothing was copied.

thickness.note: estimated - no document states the gauge. The side view dimensions 37.57 mm [1.48 in] clear between the walls and the body is 39.8 over them, so each wall is (39.8 - 37.57) / 2 = 1.1 mm, taken for the cover and the plate as well.

top.note: drawing - the top view, rear at y=0: the back 5.0 mm behind the plane of the ears, the wall, and the cover's lip over the front 9.8 mm (23 px at 2.344 px/mm; the front 62.71 to the plane is dimensioned). The 24 slots run from 9.8 mm behind the front edge, under the cover's edge, for the dimensioned 49.78, ending 3.1 mm before the plane. The bottom is the same as the top.

weight.note: datasheet - 0.59 kg (1.3 lb), the spec sheet's Unit Weight.
